# Which AI can I use with Margince?

<!-- Generated by `cd backend && go test ./internal/compose/aicert/ -run TestTheWhichAIPageIsPublished -update-which-ai` from the two test result files; do not edit by hand. -->

AI works with Margince in two ways. **Margince AI** is the AI inside the product. It has features, such as drafts, document reads and briefs, and night helpers that work while the team sleeps. **Your AI assistant** is an AI tool you connect to Margince, such as Claude Code or Codex, which works in your records for you.

| | Margince AI | Your AI assistant |
|---|---|---|
| What it is | The AI inside Margince | An AI tool you connect to Margince |
| Whose model thinks | A model your administrator sets up | The model of the assistant you use |
| Who starts the work | You, when you use a feature, and the night helpers | You, in the assistant |
| Where it is set up | **Settings**, then **AI models** | **Settings**, then **AI assistants** |
| What it may do | Suggest, with its evidence; a change waits for your approval or shows as an automatic change | What you could do yourself, and nothing more |
| How we test it | Each feature, on the product's real prompts, many tries | Everyday jobs, done from start to end, several tries |

### Which AI model should I choose for Margince?
For Margince AI, choose the model setup with the most features ready. Today that is **Anthropic Claude**, with 34 of its 38 features ready. A model setup says which model does which kind of work, and the table below shows each one we tested. Your administrator sets it up under **Settings**, then **AI models**.
Also called: which model should I use, best model, recommended model, which LLM, which provider, model tiers.

| Model setup | Where your data goes | Ready | Usable with care | Not reliable yet | Not measured |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Google Gemini | global cloud | 27 | 9 | 1 | 1 |
| Google Gemini in the EU, through Vertex AI | EU-hosted cloud | 27 | 9 | 1 | 1 |
| Anthropic Claude | global cloud | 34 | 3 | 0 | 1 |
| OpenAI GPT-6, through OpenRouter | global cloud | 19 | 3 | 3 | 13 |
| Open models from OpenAI and Mistral, through OpenRouter | global cloud | 12 | 12 | 7 | 7 |
| Gemma 4 you could run yourself, through OpenRouter | global cloud | 1 | 0 | 4 | 33 |
| Mistral models in the EU, through OpenRouter | EU-hosted cloud | 11 | 2 | 12 | 13 |
| Gemma 4 on your own server, through Ollama | your own servers | 0 | 0 | 0 | 38 |
| Qwen3 on your own server, through vLLM | your own servers | 0 | 0 | 0 | 38 |

[117 of these 197 grades](ai-certification.md#stale-records-and-why) were measured on an older version of Margince and wait for a re-check.

### What does a grade of a Margince AI feature mean?
A grade of a Margince AI feature says how often it was right. **Ready** means right in at least 90 of every 100 tries: turn it on. **Usable with care** means right in most tries: have someone look over what it makes. **Not reliable yet** means wrong too often: leave it off. **Not measured** means nobody has tested that feature on that model yet.
Also called: grade, rating, certified, how reliable is the AI.

### Which AI assistant can I connect to Margince?
You can connect an AI assistant to Margince under **Settings**, then **AI assistants**. The table shows the assistants we tested, and how many of our everyday jobs each one did reliably. A job is one errand, such as logging a call or getting ready for a meeting.
Also called: which AI tool works with Margince, Claude, Codex, Gemini, ChatGPT, is my assistant supported, MCP client.

| Assistant | How we connected it | Jobs done reliably | Can I trust it? |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `claude-sonnet-5-5` | Claude Code CLI | 81 of 81 (2 not yet run) | 🟢 Yes |
| `claude-sonnet-5-5` | Claude Agent SDK | 2 of 2 (81 not yet run) | ⚪ Not enough tested yet |
| `gemini-4-hydrogen-medium` | Antigravity CLI | 81 of 81 (2 not yet run) | 🟢 Yes |
| `gpt-5.6-sol` | Codex CLI | 80 of 82 (1 not yet run) | 🟡 Mostly |

### Can I use an AI assistant that is not in the table?
Yes. An AI assistant that is not in the table can still connect to Margince. It can do what you could do yourself, and nothing more. We have not measured how well it does the jobs, so check what it does before you rely on it.
Also called: untested assistant, another AI tool, my own agent.

The job by job results are in [Your AI assistant: test results](mcp-tool-coverage.md).

### What did you test, and what not?
For Margince AI we ran 356 test cases. Each one is an example with a known right answer, in one of the 64 places in the product where a feature calls a model. For your AI assistant, we wrote 83 everyday jobs on a test company. The table counts the jobs each assistant has run, and a job not run yet is not counted as failed. A model setup or an assistant missing from the tables above is not tested yet.
Also called: how is the AI tested, test coverage, certification.
